columns.name: firm
columns.meaning: The registry-derived firm scope this row belongs to; never a typed token.
columns.method: The firm scope of the custody entry the silver partition is read under, taken from the registry.

columns.name: account_id
columns.meaning: The account key carried by the silver row. It is an identifier and is not reproduced in any report.

columns.name: business_date
columns.meaning: The business date of the row, the date= partition it is written under: the first NYSE trading day on or after the trade date, computed by first_trading_day_on_or_after in lib/trading_calendar.py (window 14 days) for ALL THREE firms (contract 0.4.1, the CTO's round-131 ruling). 49 Financial: from its trade_date; the silver business_date column is not the answer. Cottonwood: from its Trade Date (the adapter's performance day). Inflection: from its transDate, so a Saturday or Sunday transDate rolls to the Monday.

columns.name: trade_date
columns.meaning: The trade date of the row, the source date as received and never rolled: the trade_date column of the 49 Financial table (round-128 ground read), the Trade Date of Cottonwood, the transDate of Inflection. A 49 Financial line with no readable trade_date is refused, so null is not served for that firm.

columns.name: settle_date
columns.meaning: The settlement date: the settlmnt_date column of the transaction table (round-128 ground read); for Cottonwood the Settle Date column. Null when the value is missing or unparsable; null on every Inflection row (the table has no settlement column).

columns.name: action
columns.meaning: The action word of the row: the txn_type's action through type_action. Null only when the code is not in the mapping.
columns.method: tran_srcde through source_mapping to the ratified type word, then type_action (the type word to its action word); a code the mapping holds as UNMAPPED or lacks gives a null action.

columns.name: txn_type
columns.meaning: The ratified type word of the row, or the string UNMAPPED when the mapping holds the code as UNMAPPED or lacks it.
columns.method: tran_srcde through source_mapping (the 49 Financial code to its ratified type word); UNMAPPED when the mapping holds the code as UNMAPPED or lacks it.

columns.name: symbol
columns.meaning: The security symbol, the ticker_symbol column (49 Financial), the Symbol column (Cottonwood) or the ticker column (Inflection); null on a row with no security.

columns.name: asset_name
columns.meaning: The security's name. The 49 Financial live schema (140 columns) has no name column (round-128 ground read), so the column is null on every 49 Financial row; Cottonwood reads its Asset Name column; Inflection reads productName.

columns.name: units
columns.meaning: The quantity column, named as the units (round-128 ground read); for Cottonwood the Units column; for Inflection noUnits. Null when the row carries none.

columns.name: price
columns.meaning: The price column (round-128 ground read); for Cottonwood the Price column; for Inflection navPrice ONLY on a line whose fundFamilyName is non-blank, with non-zero noUnits and a positive navPrice (price_rule and sources.inflection); every other Inflection line is null, with the reason NAV_PRICE_FUND_ONLY, ZERO_UNITS or NAV_NOT_POSITIVE. Null when the row carries none.

columns.name: amount
columns.meaning: The custodian's money amount. 49 Financial: gross_amount; on a cash row the sign is taken from debit_credit as account_return_daily takes it (CREDIT positive, DEBIT negative); on an in-kind row debit_credit is a position side and is not read as a cash sign. Cottonwood: the Market Value, signed by the External Flow word as the adapter does (+abs for Contribution, -abs for Withdrawal) and as booked otherwise. Inflection: transAmount as booked.
columns.method: gross_amount, the money column the adapter declares (money_column). The sign is taken from debit_credit on cash rows: CREDIT positive, DEBIT negative (direction_map).

columns.name: fee
columns.meaning: The stated sum, for each firm, of the columns the contract's fee_basis names (49 Financial: commission, exchange_processing_fee, broker_service_fee, prime_broker_fee, trade_away_fee, redemption_fee, other_fee, step_in_fee, research_fee; Cottonwood: Transaction Fee and Account Fee). A null column counts as nothing; a row whose named columns are all null has fee null, never zero. Inflection: null (no fee column).
columns.method: Per row, the sum of the fee-named columns listed in from_columns and of commission; null when every listed column is null. markupmarkdown is not summed (a price markup, not a fee charge) and exec_brok_comm is not summed (its meaning as a fee is not established from the census or the tracked records).

columns.name: custodian
columns.meaning: The custodian of the row, lower-cased: the custody entry's constant (sources.json custodian) for 49 Financial, and Cottonwood's Custodian column and Inflection's custodianName for those firms. The round-128 ground read names custdian_id as the custodian identity column for 49 Financial; the constant is what a person reads, and custdian_id is not read onto the row.
columns.method: The custodian constant of the custody entry (49 Financial) or the Custodian or custodianName column (Cottonwood, Inflection), stripped and lower-cased by the producer; set once per entry in the registry.

columns.name: flow_class
columns.meaning: The flow class of the row's code: EXTERNAL_IN, EXTERNAL_OUT, INCOME, FEE, INTERNAL, CORPORATE_ACTION or UNRESOLVED. 49 Financial: the tran_srcde code's class. Cottonwood: the External Flow word (Contribution EXTERNAL_IN, Withdrawal EXTERNAL_OUT) or the pair's class. Inflection: the description's class in its source_mapping row, by inflection_flow_rule.
columns.method: 49 Financial: per tran_srcde through flow_class_rule over the CRO table's (partition, rule) pairs: one class when the code's CRO rows agree, UNRESOLVED when they disagree or the table does not hold the code. The silver-only codes and IRAWH and MCE are fixed in source_mapping. Cottonwood: cottonwood_mapping (the External Flow rule, then the pair's flow_class_none). Inflection: inflection_flow_rule applied in the order NNA, CorporateAction, account_boundary in or out, Internal, Return by word. The round-128 ground read names the 49 Financial key (tran_srcde, tr_cd, sb_cd); this contract keys on tran_srcde, the key source_mapping holds.

columns.name: source_txn_id
columns.meaning: The per-transaction identifier of the row, a PER-ROW CLAIM: present where the firm's source column (49 Financial cashiering_transaction_identifier; Cottonwood TransactionID; Inflection id) is non-null and non-blank, and absent (null) where it is not. It is never a universal key: source_txn_id_coverage states each firm's coverage over every partition with its denominator.
columns.method: The per-transaction cashiering identifier column, read by name; values not read.

columns.name: coverage
columns.meaning: How the row's code is covered by the mapping: MEASURED, CODE_NOT_IN_MAPPING or UNMAPPED_BY_TABLE.
columns.method: MEASURED when tran_srcde maps to a type word; CODE_NOT_IN_MAPPING when the mapping lacks the code; UNMAPPED_BY_TABLE when the mapping holds the code as UNMAPPED.

columns.name: source_action_raw
columns.meaning: The source value the type and action were looked up from, exactly as received, unstripped: the 49 Financial tran_srcde code, the Cottonwood Action, or the Inflection transactionDescription. Null where the source cell is missing. Carried on every row, including a row the mapping does not hold.

49financial.method: tran_srcde through source_mapping to the ratified type word, then type_action (the type word to its action word); a code the mapping holds as UNMAPPED or lacks gives a null action.
tran_srcde through source_mapping (the 49 Financial code to its ratified type word); UNMAPPED when the mapping holds the code as UNMAPPED or lacks it.
gross_amount, the money column the adapter declares (money_column). The sign is taken from debit_credit on cash rows: CREDIT positive, DEBIT negative (direction_map).

Per row, the sum of the fee-named columns listed in from_columns and of commission; null when every listed column is null. markupmarkdown is not summed (a price markup, not a fee charge) and exec_brok_comm is not summed (its meaning as a fee is not established from the census or the tracked records).
The custodian identity column of the row (custdian_id). Its values are not read by the census; the claim is inferred from the column name.

Per the three-part key (tran_srcde, tr_cd, sb_cd) through the classification table's (partition, rule) rows: one class when the key's rows agree, UNRESOLVED when they disagree or the table does not hold the key. The silver-only codes and the two fixed codes are fixed in source_mapping.
The per-transaction cashiering identifier column, read by name; values not read.
MEASURED when tran_srcde maps to a type word; CODE_NOT_IN_MAPPING when the mapping lacks the code; UNMAPPED_BY_TABLE when the mapping holds the code as UNMAPPED.

cottonwood.method: The vendor Action value (87 distinct values) mapped to the Opal action word; where the Action value carries no action word, the action word of the Transaction Type through type_action.
Transaction Type (16 values) through the ratified source_mapping rows for the type field.
The transaction money value column. The census holds no values; the reading is inferred from the column name.
Per row, the sum of Transaction Fee and Account Fee; null when both are null.

Per row: External Flow Contribution maps to EXTERNAL_IN and Withdrawal to EXTERNAL_OUT; a None External Flow takes the class of the (Transaction Type, Transaction Sub Type) pair under the ratified pair rules (the census pairs table, 33 pairs).
MEASURED when the (Transaction Type, Transaction Sub Type) pair is in the mapping; CODE_NOT_IN_MAPPING when the mapping lacks the pair; UNMAPPED_BY_TABLE when the mapping holds the pair as UNMAPPED.

inflection.method: The transaction date column read as the trade date; equality with the trade date is not established.
transactionDescription (47 values) through the contract's source_mapping rows for the Inflection type field, then the type word's action word through type_action.
transactionDescription (47 values) through the contract's source_mapping rows for the Inflection type field; the Orion cashflow taxonomy keys on the same text.
productName read as the product's name; the census shows its distinct count only.

The price is navPrice ONLY on a line that carries a fund family: the fundFamilyName is non-blank, noUnits is non-zero and navPrice is positive. Every other line serves null, never zero, with the reason NAV_PRICE_FUND_ONLY (units non-zero, navPrice positive, no fund family), ZERO_UNITS (no units) or NAV_NOT_POSITIVE (units non-zero, navPrice not positive). The round-128 ground read named avgPrice for this target and read no value; the round-131 census (values-free, R131_INFLECTION_FIELD_CENSUS.json) finds avgPrice null or blank on every one of 218,054,352 rows, so the producer never reads it. The round-132 census (values-free, R132_INFLECTION_CENSUS.json) finds 154,828,670 unit-bearing rows with a positive navPrice, of which 154,828,670 carry a fund family and 0 do not; navPrice times noUnits equals transAmount within one percent on 154,808,844 of the 154,828,670 fund-family lines, so navPrice is the unit price the amount is booked at.

The description's ratified bucket in the Orion cashflow taxonomy gives the class: NNA as EXTERNAL_IN or EXTERNAL_OUT by the description's direction, Return as INCOME or FEE by the description, Internal as INTERNAL, CorporateAction as CORPORATE_ACTION; a description the taxonomy lacks is UNRESOLVED.
The table row identifier column read as the per-transaction identifier; values not read.
MEASURED when the description maps to a type word in the contract's source_mapping; CODE_NOT_IN_MAPPING when the mapping lacks it; UNMAPPED_BY_TABLE when the mapping holds it as UNMAPPED.

49financial.rule: The fee is the stated sum of the nine listed columns. For each line it is the sum of the non-null values of commission, exchange_processing_fee, broker_service_fee, prime_broker_fee, trade_away_fee, redemption_fee, other_fee, step_in_fee and research_fee. A null column counts as nothing. A line whose nine columns are all null has fee null, never zero. Excluded by the round-128 ground read: markupmarkdown (a price markup, not a fee charge) and exec_brok_comm (its meaning as a fee is not established from the census or the tracked records).

cottonwood.rule: The fee is the stated sum of Transaction Fee and Account Fee per line, read by the Cottonwood producer. A null column counts as nothing. A line whose two columns are both null has fee null, never zero.

transforms.rule: The producer strips the value and LOWER-CASES it: the 49 Financial custody constant, Cottonwood's Custodian column and Inflection's custodianName, so the word reads the same across firms. A value is lower-cased, never upper-cased or title-cased. An Inflection line whose custodianName is null or blank is refused.
transforms.method: The strip and lower-case calls in account_transaction.custodian() (49 Financial), in the Cottonwood normaliser's custodian field and in the Inflection normaliser; asserted by the offline tests of the three modules on made-up custodians.

transforms.rule: The producer strips the text; an EMPTY or BLANK value becomes NULL, never the empty string. The 49 Financial symbol is ticker_symbol; the Cottonwood symbol is Symbol; the Inflection symbol is ticker.
transforms.method: The shared text helper of each module (strip, then empty or blank to None); asserted by the offline tests on an empty and a blank symbol.

transforms.rule: The producer strips the text; an EMPTY or BLANK asset name becomes NULL. The 49 Financial column is null on every row (claim absent: the live schema has no name column); Cottonwood reads its Asset Name column; Inflection reads productName.
transforms.method: The same text helper as symbol; the 49 Financial producer sets None by construction, the other two read their column.

transforms.rule: The producer strips the text; an EMPTY or BLANK identifier becomes NULL. So a null source_txn_id is either a source identifier that was empty or blank, or one the source never carried; source_txn_id_coverage and the source column tell the two apart. The Inflection identifier is the integral id as a string, and null where id is not integral.
transforms.method: The shared text helper of each module, read from cashiering_transaction_identifier (49 Financial), TransactionID (Cottonwood) and id (Inflection); asserted by the offline tests on an empty and a missing identifier.

49financial.per_row_claim: A row's source_txn_id is PRESENT where the source column (cashiering_transaction_identifier) is non-null and non-blank, and ABSENT (null) where it is not. The column is NEVER a universal key: 214,587 of 3,349,750 rows (6.4061 percent) carry a value over all 572 partitions. 5,167 rows of the present ones share their value with another row of the same partition (229 partitions), so the identifier is not unique within every partition.

cottonwood.per_row_claim: A row's source_txn_id is PRESENT where the source column (TransactionID) is non-null and non-blank, and ABSENT (null) where it is not. The column is NEVER a universal key: 1,096,830 of 1,096,830 rows (100.0000 percent) carry a value over all 125 partitions. 3,870 rows of the present ones share their value with another row of the same partition (41 partitions), so TransactionID is not unique within every partition and is not a universal key.

inflection.per_row_claim: A row's source_txn_id is PRESENT where the source column (id) is non-null and non-blank, and ABSENT (null) where it is not. The column is NEVER a universal key: 218,054,352 of 218,054,352 rows (100.0000 percent) carry a value over all 154 partitions. No present row shares its value with another row of the same partition, on the round-130 read over every partition, so the id column is unique within each partition on that read.

flow_class_rule.reason: An account transfer is internal only when its counterparty leg is matched, and the line does not carry the counterparty.
A journal is internal or external by its counterparty, which the line does not carry.
A share delivery is internal when its other leg sits in a sister account, and the line does not state which.
A classified check's direction is not stated by the rule, so it cannot be classed until a specimen is read.
A returned deposit reverses a deposit whose direction the rule does not state, so the table does not settle its class.
The partition is money entering the account from outside the firm.
The partition is money leaving the account to outside it, and an IRA withholding is paid out of the account.
A check paid out of the account leaves the account to a payee outside it.
A withdrawal moves cash or securities from the account to outside the firm.
An administrative fee charged to the account is a fee whatever its label.
A service fee charged to the account is a fee.
An explicit advisor fee debited from the account is a management fee, which is a fee.
An advisory fee debited from the account is a fee.
A verified advisor fee is a fee against the fee record.
Alternative income is income earned inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition, which the return engine treats as inside the account.
A cash-in-lieu payment for a fractional share is a corporate action inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A corporate action on a holding is an event inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A corporate action on an in-kind position is an event inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A miscellaneous corporate action is an event inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A dividend is income earned by the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A foreign tax withheld on income is taken inside the account, so it stays an INTERNAL movement.
An interest adjustment is income inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
Interest is income earned by the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A reinvestment moves income back into the account, an INTERNAL movement.
A sweep moves cash between the account's own holdings, an INTERNAL movement.
A trade moves value between cash and a position inside the account, an INTERNAL movement.
A withholding taken inside the account is an INTERNAL movement.
The table holds no rule for the line, so its class is the table's own unresolved state.
A lending or miscellaneous in-kind line cannot be classed until a specimen shows its direction.
A miscellaneous adjustment's cash direction is not stated by the table, so it stays UNRESOLVED until a specimen is read.

inflection_flow_rule.reason: New money: an NNA line in the in direction is cash that arrives from outside the firm (a client or employer deposit, a rollover or a merge from another account).
New money: an NNA line in the out direction is cash that leaves the firm (a client distribution, a cancelled account, a transfer out to another account or an external account).
A corporate action (a split, a spin-off, an expiry) changes the holding and moves no money across the account boundary.
An internal journal whose account boundary is in: the money comes into this account from another account of the firm, so it is an external inflow for this account.
An internal journal whose account boundary is out: the money leaves this account for another account of the firm, so it is an external outflow for this account.
An internal line with no boundary direction (a trade, a sweep, a reinvestment, a corporate-action journal) stays inside the account.
A return-bucket line whose boundary is out is a tax or charge paid to an outside party (federal, state or foreign tax withheld), so the money leaves the account.
A return-bucket line with no boundary whose word is Capital gain, Dividend or Interest is income earned on the holdings and kept in the account.
A return-bucket line with no boundary whose word is Fee, Fee credit, Management fee or Trading expense is a charge or a credit of a charge taken from the account.
Any other return-bucket line with no boundary (a tax credit, a return of capital, other income) stays inside the account.

key_normalisation.rule: strip surrounding whitespace and nothing else; case is kept; the mapping's keys and every producer's lookup use this one function

49financial.rule: The code exactly as received, unstripped: the value the 49 Financial lookup is made from, carried on every row (null where the cell is missing).

cottonwood.rule: The Action exactly as received from the vendor, unstripped, carried on every row (null where the cell is missing); the lookup normalises it by the one key function.

inflection.rule: The transactionDescription exactly as received, unstripped, carried on every row (null where the cell is missing); the lookup normalises it by the one key function.

inflection.reason: Inflection's status column has six values. The Inflection adapter (adapters/inflection_account_return_daily.py, STATUS_COMPLETE) keeps Complete rows only, and so does this table: a Complete line is a transaction that happened. The five other statuses (Inactive, Pending, Pending Corporate Action, Rejected, Reversed) are not transactions that happened; they are counted per status in excluded_rows_per_status and never served. A status outside the six is refused. No other firm has a status column.

offset_rule.reason: An original and its offset leave the served set together. A Reversed line is out as Reversed (its own status, already counted in excluded_rows_per_status). A Complete line whose (accountId, ticker, noUnits, negated transAmount) equals the key of a Reversed line is the offset of that original and is counted OFFSET_OF_REVERSED. The CALLER supplies the Reversed keys (reversed_keys_of) to split_complete; the producer neither reads the table nor stores a set. The round-132 pairing census counts the candidates below (CTO round-131 ruling 1: the Reversed offsets leave the served set with their originals).

source_mapping.reason: Two rows with two meanings: the FC row (rule misc-adj, FUNDS ADJUSTMENT) is a cash funds adjustment, and the IC row (rule corp-actions-ic, POSITION ADJ) is a security position adjustment. They take different words (Adjustment and Corporate action), so the table gives this code no single meaning.
Rule misc-adj with a generic description (MISC ADJUSTMENT); the table does not say whether cash moves, and the Adjustment word is defined with no cash flow.
Rule checks-classified with the description SCHWAB CHECK; the same description is a deposit on one code and a paid check on another, and this row states neither direction, so no single word fits.
Rule cash-in-lieu; a cash payment for a fractional share. The table does not say whether a sale of the fraction or a corporate-action payment, so no single word fits.
Rule cash-in-lieu; a cash payment for a fractional share. The table does not say whether a sale of the fraction or a corporate-action payment, so no single word fits.
Rule misc-adj with no description; the table does not say whether cash moves, and the Adjustment word is defined with no cash flow.
Rule misc-adj with no description; the table does not say whether cash moves, and the Adjustment word is defined with no cash flow.

Silver-only code (not in the CRO table). The description carries the word MATURED, a security that matured. Corporate action names expiry as the issuer-side end of a holding, and a maturity is that end, so Corporate action.
Rule corp-misc with the description Litigation; the table does not say whether a settlement is income, a return of cost or a correction, so no single word fits.

Rules deposits and withdrawals under one description, MONEYLINK TRANSFER: one row is an inflow and one an outflow. The description does not give the direction, so the table gives this code no single meaning.
Rules returned-deposits, deposits and withdrawals under one empty description: the rows run in both directions. The table gives this code no single meaning.
Rule corp-misc with the description CREDIT PRO and category Dividends and Interest. The description does not say whether the credit is income or a correction, so no single word fits.
Rule no-rule with no description; the table does not say whether cash moves, and the Adjustment word is defined with no cash flow.

Silver-only code (not in the CRO table). The description carries the words PARTIAL CALL, a bond partial redemption: the same issuer redemption event as the table's REDEMP/CONVERSION codes, so Corporate action.

Silver-only code (not in the CRO table). The description carries an issuer name and no transaction word, and the AJ ending is not a basis for a meaning (the record decides on the description, never on a sub-code or a suffix), so the table and the silver give no single meaning here.

Rule deposits with the description Stop Check Payment. A stop credits back a check that was paid, a reversal of an earlier withdrawal, not an inflow from outside; the rule and the description disagree and no single word fits.

Rule deposits with the description Voided Check. A voided check credits back a check that was paid, a reversal of an earlier withdrawal, not an inflow from outside; the rule and the description disagree and no single word fits.
Rule lending-misc-ic with no description; securities lending income and a lending return cannot be told apart from the table, so no single word fits.
Internal bucket, but the yaml calls it a synthetic per-position opening seed, not a transaction a client made.
Internal bucket, but the yaml says Remark is a position seed only where a ticker is present and a cash-shaped Remark fails loud to UNRESOLVED; its meaning depends on the row shape.

cottonwood_mapping.action_derivation: A Cottonwood line whose vendor Action is null or blank (after normalising, round 131) derives its action word from its (Transaction Type, Transaction Sub Type) pair through the type table (type_action), the same rule as a 49 Financial code with no action field. The live read finds no null Action in Cottonwood, so this is a stated fallback that no observed line uses; the Action values that the vendor does carry map through cottonwood_mapping.actions.

type_pairs.reason: Buy type and Buy sub type: a purchase of a security. Contribution rows are EXTERNAL_IN by the rule, None rows INTERNAL.
Buy type with a Dividend Reinvestment sub type: income used to buy more of the same holding; no cash leaves the account.
Capital Gains type, Long-Term sub type: a long-term capital gain distribution.
Capital Gains type, Short-Term sub type: a short-term capital gain distribution.
Cash added to the account from outside; all rows are Contribution, so EXTERNAL_IN by the rule.
Cash paid out of the account to the client; all rows are Withdrawal, so EXTERNAL_OUT by the rule.
Corporate Action type: cash paid in lieu of a fractional share from an issuer event.
Corporate Action type: a conversion into the holding, caused by the issuer.
Corporate Action type: a conversion out of the holding, caused by the issuer.
Corporate Action type: a merger of holdings, caused by the issuer.
Corporate Action type: a reverse split, caused by the issuer.
Corporate Action type: a spin-off, caused by the issuer.
Corporate Action type: a split, caused by the issuer.
Dividend type and sub type: a dividend paid by a holding.
Dividend type with a Non-Taxable sub type: a dividend with a tax status, still a dividend.
Dividend type with a Qualified sub type: a dividend with a tax status, still a dividend.
Dividend paid and reinvested in the same holding; no cash leaves the account.

Expense type with a Buy of Accrued Interest sub type: the vendor words do not say whether the row is a trading cost, an income item or a cost-basis movement, so it is left undecided rather than guessed.
Expense type: a charge against the account. Withdrawal rows are EXTERNAL_OUT by the rule, None rows FEE.
Tax Withholding sub type: tax taken from the account; all rows are Withdrawal, so EXTERNAL_OUT by the rule. The ratified Tax withheld word is INTERNAL; the conflict is filed as a surprise row.
Income type: income paid to the account that is not a dividend, interest or capital gain.

Interest type with a Buy of Accrued Interest sub type: the buyer pays accrued interest, which the vendor words do not place as income or as a cost-basis movement, so it is left undecided rather than guessed.
Interest type and sub type: interest credited or paid.
Interest type with a Sale of Accrued Interest sub type: accrued interest received on a sale, read as interest.
Interest type with a Tax-Exempt sub type: municipal bond interest, interest with a tax status only.
Journal type and sub type: a book entry between accounts or sub-accounts.
Management Fee type: a fee for management; all rows are Withdrawal, so EXTERNAL_OUT by the rule.
Management Fee type with a Rebate sub type: a reversal that returns part of a fee; all rows are Contribution, so EXTERNAL_IN by the rule.

type_pairs.source_key: Return of Capital | Return of Capital
type_pairs.reason: Return of Capital type: a repayment of principal, not income; it lowers cost basis.
Sale type with a Redemption sub type: a holding sold back to its issuer or fund.
Sale type and sub type: a sale of a security. Withdrawal rows are EXTERNAL_OUT by the rule, None rows INTERNAL.
Transfer In type and sub type; all rows are Contribution, so EXTERNAL_IN by the rule.

Transfer Out type and sub type. The live read of round 130 finds no null Action in Cottonwood (87 values, none missing), so the lines that the round-128 analysis counted as lacking an Action are the lines whose External Flow is None. By the CTO's round-128 ruling (msg 9175) the pair's class for lines marked None is EXTERNAL_OUT; no line is dropped or left blank.

postulates.mece: Declared domain: the 160 live 49 Financial codes of the round-124 census, each in exactly one state. MEASURED is a code the mapping holds as a type word, UNMAPPED_BY_TABLE a code it holds as UNMAPPED, and CODE_NOT_IN_MAPPING a code the mapping lacks. Subtracting the mapped and the UNMAPPED codes from the 160 leaves none, so CODE_NOT_IN_MAPPING is 0 in the live read and the per_value counts sum to the denominator.
postulates.same_grain: Grain: one value per transaction line, read from the line's tran_srcde code through source_mapping and computed at row build. It is the grain of txn_type and flow_class; it is never an account, a day or a firm total. A code the mapping lacks is a line-level value, and the line is counted, never dropped.
postulates.intent_coherence: One intent: say whether the line's code has a ratified reading, so a reader knows whether the txn_type and action on the row are the ratified word or the Unclassified display. Each of the three values answers that one question. The money direction of a line is a different intent and belongs to flow_class, so coverage never carries it.
postulates.state_coherence: Which values one remedy does NOT move: ratifying an UNMAPPED code as a word moves only that code's rows from UNMAPPED_BY_TABLE to MEASURED; a new code in a later read moves only its own rows to CODE_NOT_IN_MAPPING until the mapping holds it. Neither remedy moves flow_class, which the CRO table gives per code, nor any other code's coverage.

postulates.mece: Declared domain: the 30 (partition, rule) pairs of the CRO classification table (187 rows, 157 distinct codes). Every pair the table holds is one of the 30 and the checker finds none outside them, so the subtraction leaves no uncovered pair. Each pair takes one of the seven classes, and a code whose rows disagree takes UNRESOLVED, so every code has exactly one class.
postulates.same_grain: Grain: one class per tran_srcde code, derived from that code's (partition, rule) rows in the CRO table and carried by each line of the code. The rule reads table rows, not account, day or amount values, so a line of the same code always carries the same class.
postulates.intent_coherence: One intent: does money cross the account boundary. EXTERNAL_IN and EXTERNAL_OUT say yes, by direction. INTERNAL, INCOME and CORPORATE_ACTION say the money stays inside the account. FEE says a charge is taken from the account. UNRESOLVED says the table does not settle the question. Every pair is classed by that one question and by nothing else.
postulates.state_coherence: Which values one remedy does NOT move: a specimen that settles one UNRESOLVED pair moves only that pair and the codes whose only row it is; it moves no EXTERNAL_IN or EXTERNAL_OUT pair. The silver-only codes and the two fixed codes are set in source_mapping and move no pair of the table, so the 30-pair rule is unchanged by them.

schema_hash_basis: sha256 over the sorted 'name:type' lines of columns joined by newline, types as the pyarrow type name the producer's ARROW_SCHEMA carries (the same method as the account_class_daily and account_return_daily contracts).
served_note: Nothing is written. No object of this table exists in any bucket. 0.4.1 supersedes 0.4.0 on the CTO round-131 rulings (round 132, DB-f-1801): one business_date for all three firms by first_trading_day_on_or_after; the Inflection price on a fund-family line only (NAV_PRICE_FUND_ONLY); the Reversed offsets counted with their originals. The round-132 censuses are stated as measured claims with the statuses the numbers give (round_132_censuses). The release is a never-widen act that waits on the CVO's judgment at L9 (DBF132-1-J1 and J2) and on a CTO and COO sign-off. 0.4.2 records the CTO's final S6 ruling (ADDENDUM 2 to the round-131 analysis, pin a5475b2fdd): both legs of the Dividend Paid from Cash / Income Paid event stay INTERNAL, so round_132_censuses.s6_status reads RULED_INTERNAL.

business_date_rule.rule: business_date is the first NYSE trading day on or after the trade date, for all three firms: the day returned by first_trading_day_on_or_after (lib/trading_calendar.py) for the firm's trade date within 14 days. 49 Financial reads its trade_date; Cottonwood its Trade Date; Inflection its transDate. trade_date is the source date as received and is never rolled. A line whose trade date has no trading day within 14 days, or none readable, is refused and counted. Each writer refuses a row whose business_date is not the date= partition it is written under (CTO round-131 ruling (c)).

s6_ruling.reason: The two descriptions are two legs of one event: every row of each has a row of the other with the same account, day and absolute amount (census v2). Counting a leg as income would count the dividend twice, because the income is booked by Dividend to Cash (INCOME).
s6_ruling.release_criterion: Per event the two legs' signed amounts sum to zero, printed as N of 14,920; any miss stops the release.
